extDescription.message: Puts tabs you haven't visited for a while into Chrome's memory saver mode and shows how much RAM it freed.

modeOnMinutes.message: Tabs idle for $MINUTES$ min are put to sleep

modeOnPressure.message: RAM is high: tabs idle for $MINUTES$ min are put to sleep
modeOnPressure.description: Header subtitle when pressure mode is active

pressurePill.description: Amber pill when pressure mode is active

pressurePillTitle.message: RAM usage is above $THRESHOLD$%, so idle tabs are put to sleep sooner

meterTitle.message: White: other usage · green: active tabs

totalGainTitle.message: Tabs put to sleep since install: $COUNT$

noteExact.description: Note under the tiles when every value is Chrome's exact figure

noteChrome.message: Values from Chrome. Those marked ≈ are approximate, for example when tabs share memory.
noteChrome.description: Note under the tiles when values come from Chrome but some are approximate

noteCalibrated.message: Estimated from your measured RAM gains (×$FACTOR$). Chrome doesn't give extensions the exact value.
noteCalibrated.description: Note under the tiles when values are scaled by the learned factor

noteLearning.message: Estimates. Chrome doesn't give extensions the exact value; they get more accurate after a few tabs are put to sleep.
noteLearning.description: Note under the tiles while the calibration is still learning

noteHeap.message: Estimates. Chrome doesn't give extensions the exact value, so real use is usually higher.
noteHeap.description: Note under the tiles when only the pages' JS memory is known

approxTitle.description: Tooltip on values/notes that use the ≈ sign

memExact.description: Tooltip on a tab's memory value

memShared.message: From Chrome, but this tab shares memory with other tabs, so its share is approximate
memShared.description: Tooltip on a tab's memory value

memCalibrated.message: Estimated from your measured RAM gains
memCalibrated.description: Tooltip on a tab's memory value

memHeap.message: Page's JS memory only — real use is higher
memHeap.description: Tooltip on a tab's memory value

memFallback.message: Rough guess — this tab couldn't be measured
memFallback.description: Tooltip on a sleeping tab's freed value

discardAllTitle.message: Put every tab to sleep except the open and locked ones

clickToSwitch.message: Click to go to this tab

cantSleep.message: This tab couldn't be put to sleep

lockedToast.message: Locked – this tab won't be put to sleep

notifyLabel.message: Notify when tabs are put to sleep

pressureMode.message: Sleep faster when RAM is high

pressureHint.message: Idle tabs sleep sooner while system RAM usage is above the threshold

whitelistPlaceholder.message:
one domain per line
e.g. youtube.com

nothingToSleep.message: No tabs to put to sleep

groups_title.description: Header of the tab group section in the popup

groups_unnamed.description: Shown for a tab group without a title

groups_tabsOne.description: Tab group sub-line: exactly one tab

groups_tabsMany.description: Tab group sub-line: number of tabs

groups_asleep.description: Tab group sub-line: number of sleeping tabs

groups_lockedPill.description: Pill on a locked tab group

groups_lockedToast.message: Group locked – its tabs won't be put to sleep

groups_sleptToast.description: Toast after putting a group to sleep

groups_nothingToSleep.message: Nothing in this group can sleep right now
groups_nothingToSleep.description: Toast when no tab in the group was eligible

groups_collapseLabel.message: Sleep a group when I collapse it

groups_collapseHint.message: Its tabs sleep right away; your usual protections (locked, pinned, playing…) still apply

guard_typingLabel.description: Settings toggle: don't put tabs with unsaved form input to sleep

guard_typingHint.message: Tabs with unsent text in a form or editor aren't put to sleep
guard_typingHint.description: Settings hint under the typing toggle

guard_mediaLabel.message: Protect tabs in calls or screen sharing
guard_mediaLabel.description: Settings toggle: don't put tabs using camera, microphone or screen capture to sleep

guard_mediaHint.message: Tabs using the camera, microphone or screen sharing stay awake
guard_mediaHint.description: Settings hint under the media toggle

reason_typing.description: Tab status pill: tab has unsaved input, so it won't be put to sleep

reason_media.description: Tab status pill: tab uses camera/microphone/screen capture, so it won't be put to sleep

idle_hint.message: The active tab in each window is never touched; locked, pinned and whitelisted tabs stay protected as usual
idle_hint.description: Hint under the 'When I'm away' heading

idle_sleepOnLock.message: Sleep tabs when the computer is locked
idle_sleepOnLock.description: Toggle: sleep background tabs when the screen locks

idle_sleepOnIdle.description: Toggle: sleep background tabs when there is no keyboard/mouse input

idle_sleepOnIdleHint.message: No keyboard or mouse activity for the time below

idle_idleAfter.description: Stepper label: minutes without input before counting as idle

idle_lastSweep.description: Small line showing the result of the last lock/idle sweep

realgain_line.description: Hero card line: real system RAM freed by the latest batch of sleeping tabs and in total

realgain_lineTotal.description: Hero card line when only the all-time measured total is known

realgain_title.message: Change in free system RAM measured a few seconds after tabs were put to sleep ($COUNT$ measurements). Other apps use memory at the same time, so this is approximate; implausible readings are ignored.
realgain_title.description: Tooltip for the measured real gain line

realgain_toast.description: Toast when a new real RAM measurement arrives

calibrate_status.description: Settings > Statistics: per-tab memory estimates are calibrated; count = real RAM measurements used, factor = real RAM / JS memory

calibrate_pending.description: Settings > Statistics: not enough real RAM measurements yet to calibrate per-tab estimates

calibrate_title.message: Per-tab numbers start as JS memory, which is lower than a tab's real RAM. Each time tabs are put to sleep, the real RAM freed is compared with their JS memory, and the typical ratio is used to estimate every tab's real usage. Resetting the total keeps this calibration.
calibrate_title.description: Tooltip for the calibration status line

calibrate_reset.description: Small button in Settings > Statistics that forgets the learned calibration

calibrate_resetToast.description: Toast after the calibration was reset

processes_label.description: Settings > General row label, followed by ': On' or ': Off'. Only shown on Chrome Dev/Canary, where the chrome.processes API exists

processes_hint.message: Reads each tab's real memory from Chrome's task manager instead of estimating it. Tabs sharing one process are split and shown with ≈
processes_hint.description: Hint under the exact memory row

processes_on.description: State of the exact memory feature

processes_off.description: State of the exact memory feature

processes_enable.description: Button that asks Chrome for the 'processes' permission

processes_enableTitle.message: Chrome may ask you to allow access to its process list

processes_disable.description: Button that gives the 'processes' permission back

processes_enabledToast.description: Toast after the permission was granted

processes_deniedToast.description: Toast when the user declined the permission

processes_disabledToast.message: Exact memory turned off – using estimates
processes_disabledToast.description: Toast after the permission was removed

processes_failedToast.description: Toast when requesting/removing the permission failed

menu_sleepOthers.message: Sleep other tabs in this window

siteTimesHint.message: These sites use their own sleep time instead of the general one. Subdomains are included.

siteTimesEmpty.message: No site-specific times yet. You can also set one from the right-click menu.

siteTimesInvalid.message: Enter a site address, e.g. mail.google.com
